name: TV/TVC Primary Runtime Binding
purpose: Reuse the released TVC binder and approved same-service activation delivery to verify and bind the existing TV/TVC primary provider-operation runtime from current canonical source without creating another runtime, listener, broker, credential route, or host.
trigger: a governed invocation requires authentic TVC primary-runtime availability rather than source-only validation
scope: the existing authorized TV/TVC primary runtime and approved system/rootless service delivery paths
reuse_instructions: Use the local scripts/run_tvc_runtime_boundary_reusable.py wrapper so the generic reusable-task trigger remains inside its admitted scripts/*.py surface. The wrapper resolves only already-local StegVerse-Labs/TVC source, runs the canonical TVC primary-runtime preflight, reuses scripts/install_tvc_primary_runtime_service.py --activate to restart only the existing approved stegtvc-primary-runtime.service, then observes the runtime boundary. It emits standardized completion evidence only when the exact binding predicates are authentically satisfied. Runtime authority remains with the existing TV/TVC-authorized runtime; GitHub has no production runtime authority.
